items.title: 15.9 Crystals se X-ray ka diffraction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation, paragraph for paragraph with the English (book) lesson.

blocks.text: X-rays bhi electromagnetic radiation hain, lekin in ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m. Diffraction dekhne ke liye grating spacing istemal hone wali radiation ki wavelength ke darje ki honi chahiye. Crystal mein atoms ki ba-qaida tarteeb aik qudrati (natural) diffraction grating ban jati hai jis ki spacing aam taur par taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m hoti hai. Crystal lattice (crystal ka jaal) ke atoms se X-rays ka bikhrao (scattering) bilkul waise hi diffraction asraat deta hai jaise aam grating par nazar aane wali roshni deti hai.

Crystals ki atomic banawat (structure) ka X-rays se mutala W.H. Bragg aur W.L. Bragg ne shuru kiya (kitab saal 1914 likhti hai) aur bari kamyabiyan hasil keen. Unhon ne dekha ke monochromatic (aik wavelength wali) X-rays ki shua crystal ki satah (plane) se aise reflect hoti hai jaise aaine se. Yeh samajhne ke liye crystal ki satah ke parallel atomic planes (atoms ki tahon) ka silsila lein jin ka darmiyani faasla (interplanar spacing) d barabar hai; Fig. 15.18 mein yeh lakeerein PP′, P₁P′₁, P₂P′₂ waghaira hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig. 9.18' ka hawala deti hai; atomic planes PP′, P₁P′₁, P₂P′₂ Fig. 15.18 mein dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Crystal mein d faasle par atomic satahein PP', P1P1' aur P2P2', jaal ke nuqton par atoms. X-ray shuaein I aur II theta zawiye par parti hain; I oopar wali satah ke A par aur II agli satah ke C par, jo A ke bilkul neeche hai, mun'akis hoti hai. A se dashed amood shua II ko B aur B' par milte hain; surkh hisse BC aur CB' har aik d sin theta hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.18: Crystal se X-rays ka diffraction (kitab ki Figure 15.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Interesting Application
blocks.text: Kitab radio waves ka diffraction dikhati hai: radio waves pahari ke kinare se mur kar us ke peeche ke gharon tak pohanch jati hain, kyunke un ki wavelength bohat lambi hai.

Farz karein X-rays ki shua kisi plane par angle θ se parti hai. Shua atoms ki oopar wali aur neeche wali dono planes se reflect ho sakti hai. Neeche wali plane se reflect hone wali shua oopar wali plane se reflect hone wali shua ke muqable mein kuch izafi faasla tay karti hai. Dono reflected shuaon ka asal path difference 2d sin θ hai (Fig. 15.18 mein d sin θ jane mein aur d sin θ aane mein). Is liye reinforcement (mazboot hone, yani roshan nishan) ke liye path difference wavelength ka poora adad guna hona chahiye:

n ko order of reflection (reflection ka darja) kehte hain. Equation 15.8 ko Bragg equation kehte hain. Agar maloom wavelength ki X-rays crystal se diffract karwayi jayen to is equation se crystal ki milti julti parallel planes ka darmiyani faasla d nikala ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Kitab do tasaveer dikhati hai: 100 slits wali grating aur 2000 slits wali grating se safed roshni ka spectrum. 2000 slits wali grating ke spectrum mein rang zyada saaf aur alag alag nazar aate hain, kyunke zyada slits se maxima patle aur tez hote hain.
X-ray diffraction biology ke ahem molecules ki banawat maloom karne mein bohat mufeed raha hai, jaise haemoglobin (jo khoon ka ahem hissa hai) aur DNA ki double helix banawat.
Hal shuda misal (izafi, kitab ki nahi)

blocks.title: Izafi misal
blocks.problem: 1.54 × 10⁻¹⁰ m wavelength ki X-rays aik crystal se 15.9° ke glancing angle par first-order reflection deti hain. Planes ka darmiyani faasla d maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: λ = 1.54 × 10⁻¹⁰ m, θ = 15.9°, n = 1; maloom karna hai d.
Bragg equation: 2d sin θ = nλ, is liye d = nλ/(2 sin θ)

blocks.prompt: Aam lines wali grating X-rays ka diffraction dikhane ke liye kyun kaam nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: Aam grating ki spacing (taqreeban 10⁻⁶ m) X-ray wavelength (taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m) se hazaron guna bari hai, is liye diffraction ke angles bohat hi chhote hote hain. Crystal mein atoms ka faasla X-ray wavelength ke barabar darje ka hai, is liye crystal grating ka kaam karta hai.

items: X-rays: wavelength taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m; crystal qudrati grating (spacing taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m).
Path difference 2d sin θ; Bragg equation 2d sin θ = nλ (15.8), n = order of reflection.
Istemal: planes ka faasla d; haemoglobin aur DNA ki banawat.
